contradicting_evidence: Positive latest settled BTC and ETH ETF flows could help stabilization if repeated; the supplied session does not establish persistence.
The positive hourly repair and observed aggressive spot buying show that demand is present despite the preceding decline.
The 90d median alt return remained positive at approximately 16.67%, although below BTC's return. Longer-window participation is therefore not uniformly negative.
There is no supplied evidence establishing that current selling pressure will persist throughout the full week.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: The week-ahead balance leans toward incomplete repair and renewed downside tests rather than durable broad expansion. Countertrend rebounds remain plausible, and neither a continuous decline nor a specific retest date is supported. Confidence is lower than at 72h because the weekly outcome depends heavily on flow persistence and participation changes not yet observed.
falsification_conditions: Sustained BTC and ETH resilience accompanied by stronger ETH/BTC, broader positive participation and repeated favorable settled flows would overturn the downside lean.
Stablecoin supply stabilization or expansion together with evidence of deployment would weaken the liquidity headwind; supply improvement alone would not confirm recovery.
Persistent gains across the observed capitalization buckets would challenge the weak-transmission assessment, while leaving microcap transmission unassessed.
missing_evidence: Several additional settled ETF sessions establishing whether the latest positive flows persist.

Updated stablecoin supply and evidence linking available liquidity to actual risk-asset demand.
Current catalyst and macro developments relevant to the forecast week.

supporting_evidence: Stablecoin supply declined approximately 1.81% over 7d and 4.26% over 30d, providing a broader liquidity headwind beyond the hourly rebound.
The 30d altseason measure showed only 11 of 49 constituents outperforming BTC, with median alt returns approximately -16.63%; this is weak participation, not a durable expansion signal.
ETH was weaker than BTC over both the supplied 24h window and latest completed hour, leaving leadership unconfirmed.
Observed large-, mid- and small-alt proxy buckets all had negative median and equal-weight 24h returns. Their relative resilience does not establish positive capital transmission.
